params.message:
The report reader opens the links of the file

The reader shows a report as pictures of its pages, and a picture carries no link: a
source in the list at the back opened from the PDF and not from the reader. The
pipeline now sends where each link lies on its page; they are kept with the report and
laid back over the page, only for the pages a reader is shown.

A link opens in a new tab. The browser leaves full screen for that, and the reader now
stays open on the page it was on.

A file that is already here still takes a newer page count and links, so a report
fetched before the pipeline sent them does not wait for its next change.

Portal: In de leesweergave van een rapport kan je de bronnen achteraan nu aanklikken.
